text: Jumeirah, the luxury hotel group, is a member of Dubai Holding, which trade press describes as the parent company of the Jumeirah luxury hotel brand.

source.name: Jumeirah: About Jumeirah (undated corporate page, read 30 September 2026)
source.quote: Jumeirah, a global leader in luxury hospitality and a member of Dubai Holding, operates an exceptional portfolio of 29 properties across 11 countries

additionalSources.name: TOPHOTELNEWS: Dubai Holding Buys Jumeirah Mallorca
additionalSources.quote: Dubai Holding, parent company of the Jumeirah luxury hotel brand, has acquired the group's hotel in Mallorca
